candidates.source_name: HIPA – Hungarian Investment Promotion Agency (news/press room, HU + EN)
candidates.why_relevant: HIPA is the state body that co-announces every subsidised business service centre (SSC/GBS) investment, including those of foreign banks and asset managers, with explicit headcount figures (e.g. Janus Henderson 400 jobs in Budapest, BMW BSC 50 jobs in Debrecen). Announcements typically precede actual hiring by 6-18 months, making it the earliest hard signal of planned bank back-office headcount growth in Hungary.
candidates.source_subtype: government investment promotion agency press room
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic crawl of /hir/ (HU) and /news/ (EN) listing pages; extract title, date, company, city, job count, investment volume; filter on finance/BSC keywords.
queries_used: HIPA beruházás szolgáltatóközpont bank Budapest munkahely bővítés

candidates.source_name: HOA – Hungarian Service and Outsourcing Association (Magyar Szolgáltatóipari és Outsourcing Szövetség)

Best single pointer source for the cell.
candidates.access_status: partly open (reports sometimes members-only or gated PDF)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Harvest member directory + news; fetch annual sector report PDFs when public; supplement with secondary reporting (BBJ) when the report is gated.
candidates.discovered_via_method: search snowball from GBS sector query, en
queries_used: Hungarian Service and Outsourcing Association HOA business services sector report Budapest
candidates.observed_blocker: hoa.hu root URL inferred from association name — treat domain as unverified until liveness pass

candidates.source_name: European Business Services Association – news
candidates.why_relevant: Aggregates CEE GBS/SSC expansion and hiring announcements including Budapest finance/banking centres (Janus Henderson 400 hires, Sanofi +500, BMW Debrecen). candidates.suggested_collection_method: RSS/listing crawl with country filter Hungary; entity-extract company, city, headcount delta.

negative_findings.description: Hungarian-language searches for a bank-operated shared-service/back-office centre in Szeged ('Szeged szolgáltató központ', 'banki szolgáltató központ bővítés létszám') returned no bank-specific centre. Results were dominated by university service units, generic job boards and unrelated employers.
negative_findings.result_summary: No evidence located in this run of a foreign-bank GBS/SSC presence in Szeged; the Szeged leg of the cell may be an empty geography rather than an under-covered one.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents over-allocating collection effort to Szeged and flags that Debrecen (BMW BSC, EDC-driven) and Budapest carry nearly all of the cell's signal.

negative_findings.description: Searches for Debrecen-based banking back-office expansion in Hungarian ('Debrecen banki szolgáltató központ bővítés létszám') surfaced only retail branch openings (MBH Bank Debrecen) and a non-bank BSC (BMW). No dedicated foreign-bank service centre in Debrecen was identified.
negative_findings.result_summary: Debrecen's BSC ecosystem appears to be automotive/industrial-led rather than banking-led so far; banking signal there is currently branch-network, not back-office.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell's premise (bank GBS in Debrecen/Szeged) is only partially supported by evidence; monitoring should still run because EDC/HIPA pipelines could change this, but expectations should be calibrated.

negative_findings.description: Erste Hungary's ErStep trainee programme communications were found only on LinkedIn; LinkedIn is behind an authwall and its terms prohibit automated collection.
negative_findings.result_summary: Signal exists but is not lawfully collectable by crawler; requires manual analyst review or licensed data.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A significant graduate-pipeline signal for one of Hungary's top-5 banks is structurally unavailable to automated collection.

negative_findings.description: The HOA association's own website domain (hoa.hu) was inferred from the association name and secondary coverage rather than confirmed by a direct search hit; all substantive HOA content encountered was via BBJ, Issuu and SlideShare re-publications.
negative_findings.result_summary: HOA is confirmed to exist and publish annual sector reports, but its canonical URL is a hypothesis pending the deterministic liveness pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The single most valuable pointer source in the cell has an unconfirmed entry point; if wrong, collection must fall back to mirrors.

negative_findings.description: The only Szeged municipal investor page found sits on 'regi.szegedvaros.hu' (regi = legacy/old), indicating a site migration; the current investor section of the Szeged municipality was not located.
negative_findings.result_summary: Legacy archive available; live equivalent unidentified — a 404 or redirect on the current site should not be read as the source being dead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Risks losing the municipal channel for the Szeged geography entirely if the legacy URL is retired.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated, structured public register of university–bank cooperation agreements exists beyond the MNB's own higher-education network page; agreements with commercial banks are announced ad hoc in individual university press rooms.
negative_findings.result_summary: Coverage of this signal requires N separate university press-room crawls rather than one register.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Raises collection cost and creates a real risk of missing agreements at regional universities (Debrecen, Szeged, Pécs, Miskolc) that were not crawled in this run.

coverage_gaps.description: Regional universities outside Budapest — Debreceni Egyetem, Szegedi Tudományegyetem, Miskolci Egyetem, Pécsi Tudományegyetem — were not individually crawled for bank partnership and traineeship announcements; only Corvinus and BME were covered.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add each regional university's Hungarian press room and career-office pages to the source set and re-run the 'együttműködési megállapodás + bank' query per institution.

coverage_gaps.description: County chambers of commerce (Hajdú-Bihar and Csongrád-Csanád Kereskedelmi és Iparkamara) and county government offices (kormányhivatal) labour-market bulletins were not explored, despite being the bodies that publish local vacancy statistics and host employer announcements.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search and add 'HBKIK', 'CSMKIK' and kormanyhivatalok.hu county labour-market statistics pages as indirect quantitative sources.

coverage_gaps.description: Commercial real-estate/office-market sources (CBRE, Colliers, JLL Budapest office market reports, Debrecen office park leasing news) were not covered. Large office lettings by financial GBS tenants precede headcount ramp-ups and are publicly reported.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add Budapest/regional office-market research publications and property news as an early leading indicator layer for service-centre expansion.

coverage_gaps.description: State-aid and subsidy decision records (individual government decrees on 'egyedi kormánydöntés' / EKD subsidies published in Magyar Közlöny) were not searched, although these are the legally mandated publication of every subsidised job-creation project including service centres.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add Magyar Közlöny / njt.hu monitoring for EKD support decisions naming financial-sector beneficiaries and job counts — the most authoritative and earliest dated record.

coverage_gaps.description: Employer-brand and graduate-survey sources (e.g. Randstad Employer Brand Research Hungary, Universum/Most Attractive Employers rankings, Diákmunka/graduate career fairs at regional universities) were not covered; these reveal which banks are competing hardest for the graduate pool.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add annual employer-brand rankings and regional university career-fair exhibitor lists.

coverage_gaps.description: No Hungarian-language equivalent term was identified for 'GBS' as used locally; Hungarian coverage uses 'üzleti szolgáltató központ' / 'szolgáltató központ' / 'SSC', while 'GBS' appears almost exclusively in English-language trade press.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Standardise the HU query glossary on 'üzleti szolgáltató központ', 'szolgáltatóközpont', 'SSC', 'osztott szolgáltató központ' and flag 'szolgáltató központ' as noisy (it also matches university and municipal service offices).

brief: The A5 regional/indirect landscape for Hungary is anchored by two reliable, dateable publishers: HIPA's bilingual press room, which announces every subsidised business-service-centre investment with explicit headcount figures, and the HOA sector association, whose annual benchmark report maps the ~200 centres and their growth intentions (mirrored via BBJ and Issuu when gated). Local depth is real but uneven: Debrecen has a dense municipal/press stack (EDC Debrecen, haon.hu, hajdupress.hu) that reliably surfaces centre openings before national press, while Szeged produced no bank-specific service-centre evidence in this run and looks closer to an empty geography than an under-covered one. The talent-pipeline weak signal is best read from Corvinus and BME press rooms (MBH Bank strategic partnership feeding internship/Start+; OTP cybersecurity tie-up; MNB's higher-education network register), plus the Műegyetemi Állásbörze exhibitor roster and bank career portals — with Erste's ErStep pipeline visible only behind LinkedIn's authwall. Biggest remaining gaps are the EKD state-aid decisions in Magyar Közlöny (the most authoritative early record of subsidised job creation) and regional universities outside Budapest.
